title: The Phantom of Heilbronn
style: stylized 3D cartoon detective story, soft cel shading, cinematic noir lighting, warm amber lamp light against deep teal shadows, muted palette, vertical 9:16 composition, no text

shots.narration: For sixteen years, police hunted the most wanted woman in Europe.
shots.prompt: detective evidence board covered in newspaper clippings and red string, a blank silhouette mugshot with a red question mark in the center, desk lamp glow

shots.narration: Her DNA turned up at forty crime scenes.
shots.prompt: old paper map of Germany, Austria and France pinned to a corkboard, dozens of red pins clustered across it
moonlit kitchen at night, a smashed window pane with cracks radiating outward, flashlight beam cutting through the dark

shots.narration: She even left it on half a cookie, inside a trailer.
shots.prompt: close-up of a half-eaten cookie on a trailer table, a yellow evidence marker numbered 17 beside it, flashlight beam

shots.narration: In 2007, she was linked to the murder of a young police officer in Heilbronn.
shots.say: In two thousand seven, she was linked to the murder of a young police officer in Heilbronn.
shots.prompt: police car parked at night in a quiet German town square, blue and red lights glowing, crime scene tape in the foreground
tired detective in a fedora sitting at a cluttered desk under a green lamp, staring at a monitor showing a blank silhouette with a question mark

shots.narration: No witness ever saw her. No camera ever caught her.
shots.prompt: wall of security camera monitors showing empty streets and static, timestamp overlays, dark control room

shots.narration: The reward climbed to three hundred thousand euros.
shots.prompt: newspaper front page with a huge 300,000 euro reward headline and a silhouette wanted poster

shots.narration: Then her DNA showed up on a man's body. Impossible.
shots.prompt: lab report on a desk with a red MATCH stamp, a male silhouette with a red question mark, harsh desk light

shots.narration: So they checked the one thing found at every crime scene.
shots.prompt: forensic lab bench at night, evidence kit open, a gloved hand reaching for a sealed sterile packet
dramatic close-up of a single cotton swab in a sterile packet glowing under a spotlight

shots.narration: The DNA belonged to a factory worker who packed them. The Phantom never existed.
shots.prompt: evidence board with the silhouette mugshot torn down, a red CASE CLOSED stamp, morning light through the window
